no_forced_feature_for_credit.classification: Current CanonicalComparison already distinguishes exact consumed-stream equality and glyph/control position+sequence/ordered argument/payload differences, while nil plus Canonical.Error/Observed.Error distinguishes unavailable. A new coarse verdict string would be convenience derived from these facts, not a missing comparison algorithm. Current Status=compared concerns original side; documentation must keep this explicit. A three-way unpatched label must never override canonical==original.
no_forced_feature_for_credit.unknowns: The original ground_truth report itself emits ENCODE_UNVERIFIABLE for unsupported control semantics. Refusing opaque source authoring with explicit error is a meaningful unknown, not evidence that every opaque producer must be implemented before any canonical-audit milestone can be assessed.
no_forced_feature_for_credit.scope_accounting: Conversely, passing a single short literal row is insufficient. The source-backed plain/mixed/prologue policies and mismatch/unknown/ownership cases above are required common responsibilities. Native reader source pools and full report joins remain open; no14-family status/denominator changes proposed here.

next_high_value_shared_increment.exact_semantics: Read exactly16B/eightu16 per declared inline field. Zero is SPACE/pad and does NOT terminate; no f800 END is present. Reject controls/unknown glyphs in the original field, encode canonical EN with existing nonterminated plain-glyph encode, refuse overflow, zero-pad to declared capacity, compare exact fullfield observed bytes first to canonical and then original; neither is investigate. next_high_value_shared_increment.must_not_fake: Inline UTF16 fields are not data pointers: original site has struct_vma+field_offset+stride but NO pointer_vma. Current reference_observed struct_table_field means an actual pointerword. Never fabricate one to satisfy existing bound-family requirements; explicit inline-field ownership/mapping must be source-proven separately.
next_high_value_shared_increment.family_gap_beyond_it: Sentinel range derives installed redirect-hook words/length, not registry patch_ref/landing. Non-ELF source pools, fixed reader variants, divergent/missing coverage and evidence-bound proposed updates remain genuinely different obligations. Fixed16B support alone would not close either whole family.
